The surrounding context clearly establishes that the retinal degeneration observed is a phenotype of CLN10 disease in this model system.

The quote states that mice 'lacking cathepsin D' are 'an animal model of congenital CLN10 disease'. This establishes a deficiency/loss of cathepsin D as the cause of the disease model, not that cathepsin D itself causes the disease. The relationship incorrectly attributes causation to the gene/protein rather than to its deficiency. A 'causes' relationship for cathepsin D would be contradicted by the stated mechanism.
